1445-4871-5147-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5147-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

6406-7673-7674.description:
Cast Arachne for its web-slinging cost, tapping Spider-Man to convoke the spell through Dazzling Theater and then returning Spider-Man from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Spider-Man for its web-slinging cost, tapping Arachne to convoke the spell through Dazzling Theater and then returning Arachne from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1477-5131-8176--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-5131-8176--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

206-529-3197-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4871-8095-8168.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-2393-3249--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-2393-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

971-4687-4702.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
971-4687-4702.description:
Activate Splinter Twin by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

4826-5003-6495-6644.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.
4826-5003-6495-6644.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

586-864-2511-3125-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2511-3125-6351.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

654-851-2557-4365-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4716-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4716-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
4716-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

3532-5078-7356-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7356-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot and Medusa trigger.
Resolve the Longshot trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Medusa trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7725.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1061-5900-7679.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Recruiter of the Guard using Lilysplash Mentor.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-5434-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

206-3259-4302-4509.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
206-3259-4302-4509.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-5256-5470-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

240-1115-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2448-5220-7286.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-5220-7286.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-2919-3129-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2919-3129-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3062-3789-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-1753-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-1753-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3490-4068-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
You control at least one Mountain.
3490-4068-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

328-2034-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2034-5220-6900.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1793-5220-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {0}.
Marketback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Harvester of Souls.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Marketback Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Marketback Walker from your library.
Repeat.

2173-3845-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3525-4289-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Servant of Tymaret.
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

2018-5570-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Nardole.
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Nardole didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1429-4779-6792.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

1479-2783-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2783-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

851-3951-5658.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to create two token copies of Éomer and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Put both Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Éomer tokens trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

856-5226-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

2034-3689-6263.description:
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Mendicant Core triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy the Workshop Assistant spell, creating a token copy of it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning another artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning the nontoken Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2532-4617-4730-4906.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-4617-4730-4906.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin abilities, adding eight {R} and giving creatures you control trample until end of turn.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Jaxis' ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Jaxis abilities, creating a token that's a copy of each other creature you control with haste.
Put the token Agrus Kos into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Agrus Kos and Sparring Mummy tokens trigger.
Resolve the Agrus Kos trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sparring Mummy trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat, using the Soulbright Flamekin token instead.

32-1750-1979-5261.notablePrerequisites: Efreet Flamepainter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
32-1750-1979-5261.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Efreet Flamepainter.
Efreet Flamepainter triggers, causing you to cast Temporal Trespass from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Trespass, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Temporal Trespass from exile into your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

575-897-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1492-5445-5660.notablePrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Evolution Witness.
1492-5445-5660.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Activate Welding Jar by tapping and sacrificing it.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Welding Jar ability, regenerating target artifact.
Repeat.

413-2525-2947.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, its Vesperlark ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1409-2895-3478-4826.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-2895-3478-4826.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters untapped due to Archelos, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

877-4254-4484-5147.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
877-4254-4484-5147.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ebondeath, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

152-2719-4155.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of The Stasis Coffin.
Activate the Stasis Coffin token by paying {2}, tapping and exiling it, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.

257-2773-5038.description:
Cast Green Dragon by paying {4}{G}{G}.
Green Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Warstorm Surge.
Resolve the Green Dragon trigger, causing any creature your opponent control that are dealt damage this turn to be destroyed.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing damage equal to Green Dragon's power to any creature an opponent controls.
Green Dragon triggers, destroying the creature dealt damage.
The creature dies, triggering Overseer of the Damned's second ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, dealing damage equal to the Zombie's power to any creature an opponent controls.
Repeat from step 5.

245-1339.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
245-1339.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Marneus, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

973-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Matter Reshaper
When Matter Reshaper dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Matter Reshaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library 
Resolve the Matter Reshaper trigger, revealing Matter Reshaper from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1964-1987-3075-3227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1964-1987-3075-3227.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

225-539-1257-1671.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Walking Atlas as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

957-1271-3212.description:
Tap Scroll Rack and pay {1} to activate it, putting Time Stretch on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Time Stretch, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {6}{U}{U}, granting you two extra turns.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
